$comment: Ovrly contracts 0.2.0-draft (pre-1.0). POST /v1/uploads/{id}/complete takes no body today; this schema pins that so a future field is a visible contract change.
title: UploadCompleteRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/uploads/{id}/complete. Empty: the server re-reads the stored bytes and compares them with the declaration. A client may send no body or an empty JSON object; any field is a validation error.
